mapper.sql: select i.*, u.nickname as sellerName, u.student_no as sellerStudentNo, c.name as categoryName, (select img.image_data from item_image img where img.item_id = i.id order by img.sort_no limit 1) as coverImage, exists(select 1 from deal d where d.item_id = i.id and d.status = 'PENDING') as reserved from item i left join `user` u on i.seller_id = u.id left join category c on i.category_id = c.id

where.if: and (i.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or i.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
order by i.price asc order by i.price desc order by i.view_count desc order by i.created_at desc
limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
select image_data from item_image where item_id = #{itemId} order by sort_no
mapper.update: update item set view_count = view_count + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select ifnull(round(avg(rating), 1), 0) as avgRating, count(*) as reviewCount, ifnull(sum(rating - 3), 0) as ratingDelta from review where target_id = #{sellerId}
mapper.update: update item set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update item set status = 'SOLD', sold_buyer_id = #{buyerId}, sold_price = #{dealPrice}, sold_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update item set status = 'SOLD', sold_buyer_id = null, sold_price = null, sold_at = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into item (seller_id, category_id, title, description, price, original_price, condition_level, campus, status, view_count) values (#{sellerId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{conditionLevel}, #{campus}, 'ON_SALE', 0)
insert into item_image (item_id, image_data, sort_no) values (#{itemId}, #{imageData}, #{sortNo})
